name: qualification-10k
description: 10k input qualification cell. Same workload as screening-10k but with a 1024-token output ceiling. Screening at 256 tokens cut 117 of 120 responses at the ceiling; the three that finished naturally used 217-249 tokens, so 256 sat right at the natural boundary. 1024 gives roughly 4x the observed natural completion length. This profile is NOT sufficient for qualification on its own: see docs/qualification/10k-slo-contract.md.

qualification.note: One cell in a multi-window design. A single window never yields a qualification verdict. Performance thresholds in the contract are unratified, so the only reachable verdict today is `inconclusive`.
